$comment: Representative routes for the Lighthouse matrix (scripts/perf/lighthouse-matrix.mjs).
One entry per route FAMILY, derived from lib/site-map.ts (50 pages). Dynamic routes use fixed,
public, published ids so production and a local candidate render the same content: the local
candidate reads the production API, so the ids resolve identically in both.
The public profile uses the reviewer's UUID, not the handle: production before BUG-030 only
resolves ids, and a baseline that 404s measures an error page.
Signed-in pages are absent on purpose: engineering holds no production session and does not
create one. See docs/PERFORMANCE_AUDIT.md for how those were measured instead.
